about: Victor D. Vital, an attorney with Haynes and Boone, LLP in Dallas, Texas, helps clients address Business Litigation situations. He also helps clients with Criminal Defense: White Collar concerns.
He received legal training from Texas Southern University Thurgood Marshall School of Law. He graduated from law school in 1995. Victor Vital became licensed to practice law in 1995.
Victor Vital was selected to Super Lawyers. The designation means that he is a top-rated attorney as recognized by peers. He was selected to Super Lawyers for 2005 - 2026.
